ValidationRule.description: A Closed Won or Closed Lost sale is a stored record: every editable field, vehicle included, is frozen. Only System Administrators and heads of department can change it.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT(ISNEW()), $Profile.Name <> "System Administrator", NOT(OR( $UserRole.DeveloperName = "Showroom_Manager", $UserRole.DeveloperName = "Head_of_Finance", $UserRole.DeveloperName = "Head_of_Customer_Service", $UserRole.DeveloperName = "Management" )), OR( ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(StageName), "Closed Won"), ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(StageName), "Closed Lost") ), OR( ISCHANGED(StageName), ISCHANGED(CloseDate), ISCHANGED(Amount), ISCHANGED(AccountId), ISCHANGED(Payment_Mode__c), ISCHANGED(Name), ISCHANGED(OwnerId), ISCHANGED(Type), ISCHANGED(CampaignId), ISCHANGED(Probability), ISCHANGED(Viewing_Date__c), ISCHANGED(Expected_Collection_Date__c), ISCHANGED(Discount_Amount__c), ISCHANGED(Fleet_Rate_Applied__c), ISCHANGED(Instalment_Term_Months__c), ISCHANGED(Instalment_Down_Payment__c), ISCHANGED(LeadSource), ISCHANGED(NextStep), ISCHANGED(Description), ISCHANGED(Vehicle_Model_Wanted__c), ISCHANGED(Vehicle__c), ISCHANGED(Sale_Price__c) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: This opportunity is closed and can't be changed. Only a head of department can change a closed opportunity. If the customer wants something different, create a new opportunity for them from their account; their details are already saved.
